title: Farmers' Preferences for Riparian Buffers: Evidence from the Chesapeake Bay Watershed
abstract: Installation of riparian buffers on farmland is a high priority for agencies seeking to reduce agricultural nonpoint water pollution. While substantial subsidies are available through contracts, buffer adoption rates greatly lag implementation goals. We conduct a choice experiment of landowners in the Chesapeake Bay Watershed to examine preferences regarding contract requirements and simulate buffer supply curves under different requirements. We find that current contract designs hinder buffer adoption and that modifications could increase adoption substantially with minimal additional public expenditure. Our results also show that buffer supply is price-inelastic, further highlighting the potential gain from providing more flexible contract designs.
abstract_zh: 在农田中设置河岸缓冲带，是寻求减少农业非点源水污染的机构的首要任务。尽管通过合同可获得可观的补贴，但缓冲带的采用率远低于实施目标。我们对切萨皮克湾流域的土地所有者开展了选择实验，以考察他们对合同要求的偏好，并模拟不同要求下的缓冲带供给曲线。我们发现，现行合同设计阻碍了缓冲带的采用，而适当修改合同可以在公共支出增加极少的情况下显著提高采用率。我们的结果还表明，缓冲带供给对价格缺乏弹性，这进一步凸显了提供更灵活合同设计所带来的潜在收益。

title: Multiple dimensions of trust build public support for environmental management
abstract: Developing public trust in natural resource management agencies is crucial for effective governance and environmental management. However, trust is a multidimensional, rather than monolithic, concept, and the relative importance of different dimensions of trust in generating support for environmental management has not been fully explored. In this study, we use the trust ecology framework to examine the role of affinitive, dispositional, procedural, and rational trust in support for fisheries management among recreational anglers in the Great Lakes region of the United States. We found that all dimensions of trust positively correlate with support for management, with rational trust being the strongest predictor. Demographic factors such as age, gender, and race showed minimal impact compared to trust dimensions. Our findings underscore the multifaceted nature of trust and its critical role in resource management and suggest that building and maintain multiple dimensions of trust can enhance public support for environmental management, ultimately leading to more effective and resilient environmental governance.
abstract_zh: 公众对自然资源管理机构建立信任，对于有效的治理和环境管理至关重要。然而，信任是一个多维概念，而非单一概念，不同维度的信任在促进环境管理支持方面的相对重要性尚未得到充分探讨。在本研究中，我们运用信任生态框架，考察情感性信任、倾向性信任、程序性信任和理性信任在美国五大湖地区休闲垂钓者支持渔业管理中的作用。我们发现，信任的各个维度均与对管理的支持呈正相关，其中理性信任是最强的预测因素。年龄、性别和种族等人口统计学因素与信任维度相比影响极小。我们的发现强调了信任的多面性及其在资源管理中的关键作用，并表明建立和维持多维度的信任，可以增强公众对环境管理的支持，最终促成更有效、更具韧性的环境治理。

title: Excess Vulnerability from Subsidized Flood Insurance: Housing Market Adaptation When Premiums Equal Expected Flood Damage
abstract: We calculate there are 8.1% more houses in Allegheny County, PA (Pittsburgh) due to flood insurance subsidies. Conversely, if/when National Flood Insurance Program (NFIP) premiums rise by 50% to equal expected damages, property values will decrease by 8.8% in the short-term, with about half of that recuperated in the long run (4.7%) as quality-adjusted housing stocks contract by 7.5% over decades. This analysis informs community planning and current NFIP revisions that strive to balance solvency and social consequences. Furthermore, our extension of Poterba’s (1984) dynamic user-cost of housing model can be used in integrated assessment models of climate change adaptation.
abstract_zh: 我们测算发现，由于洪水保险补贴，宾夕法尼亚州阿勒格尼县（匹兹堡）的住房数量多出8.1%。反之，若/当国家洪水保险计划（NFIP）的保费上涨50%，使其等于预期损失时，房产价值在短期内将下降8.8%，其中约一半在长期内得以恢复（4.7%），同时经质量调整的住房存量在数十年间将收缩7.5%。本分析为社区规划以及当前旨在平衡偿付能力与社会后果的NFIP修订提供了参考。此外，我们对Poterba（1984）动态住房使用者成本模型的扩展，可用于气候变化适应的综合评估模型。

Dynamics and Uncertainty in Land-Use Conversion for Perennial Energy Crop Production: Exploring Effects of Payments for Ecosystem Services Policies
abstract: Perennial energy crops like switchgrass that are used for biofuel production have the potential to generate various water quality benefits such as reduced nitrogen runoff. Yet the current expected returns to switchgrass are not profitable enough for these crops to be widely adopted by U.S. farmers due to relatively unstable yields, volatile revenues, and high costs of crop establishment. This study uses a dynamic economic model to investigate the uncertainties in the yields and costs of switchgrass production, in comparison with those of corn-soybeans in the Chesapeake Bay Watershed in Pennsylvania. Results indicate that farmers would be willing to convert corn-soybeans to switchgrass land use with the provision of payments for ecosystem services (PES). A targeted PES policy based on the environmental effectiveness of the crop land is found to be slightly more effective in providing nitrogen reductions than a uniform PES policy with cost savings of 8–19%. Moreover, switchgrass has the potential of providing energy supply while reducing greenhouse gases emissions.
abstract_zh: 用于生物燃料生产的多年生能源作物（如柳枝稷）具有减少氮径流等多种水质效益的潜力。然而，由于产量相对不稳定、收入波动较大以及作物种植建立成本高昂，目前柳枝稷的预期收益不足以使其被美国农民广泛采用。本研究使用动态经济模型，考察柳枝稷生产在产量和成本方面的不确定性，并与宾夕法尼亚州切萨皮克湾流域的玉米-大豆轮作进行比较。结果表明，在提供生态系统服务付费（PES）的情况下，农民愿意将玉米-大豆用地转为柳枝稷用地。研究发现，基于农田环境效果的定向PES政策，在减少氮排放方面略优于统一PES政策，并可节约8%至19%的成本。此外，柳枝稷在提供能源供应的同时，还具有减少温室气体排放的潜力。

title: The Aftermath of Flood Zone Remapping: The Asymmetric Impact of Flood Maps on Housing Prices
abstract: We propose a theoretical framework characterizing (1) the attenuation of flood risks revealed by the flood zone designation in flood insurance rate maps and (2) the asymmetric impacts of adding versus removing flood zone status on property values. We apply spatial fixed effects models to empirically investigate the impacts of flood zone status and test the proposed theory. The results indicate that housing values decrease by more than 11% when a property is assigned into a flood zone. However, property values do not rebound when flood zone status is removed. (JEL Q51)
abstract_zh: 我们提出一个理论框架，刻画了（1）洪水保险费率图中洪泛区划定所揭示的洪水风险弱化，以及（2）将房产纳入或移出洪泛区对房产价值产生的不对称影响。我们运用空间固定效应模型对洪泛区状态的影响进行实证考察，并检验所提出的理论。结果显示，当房产被划入洪泛区后，房屋价值下降超过11%。然而，当洪泛区状态被解除后，房产价值并未反弹。（JEL Q51）

title: The Impact of Biomass Crop Assistance Program on the United States Forest Product Market: An Application of Global Forest Product Model
abstract: As the largest consumer of petroleum and second highest producer of greenhouse gas emissions, the United States currently is a leading country in bioenergy production driven by a series of policies. One such public program that directly subsidizes biomass feedstock growers is the Biomass Crop Assistance Program (BCAP), which recently received attention for stimulating the development of bioenergy. However, critiques were also raised, concerning the possibility of intensifying the feedstock competition between bioenergy and forest products. This study, therefore, aimed at assessing the effects of BCAP on the forest product markets with the Global Forest Products Model (GFPM). Three alternative scenarios were designed to simulate three payments in BCAP. In the first scenario, the matching payment was simulated by adjusting the manufacturing cost of fuelwood and particleboard. In the second scenario, establishment payment was simulated by adjusting the supply rate of industrial roundwood. In the third scenario, the annual payment was simulated by linking the supply change rate with the soil rental rate for industrial roundwood. We found that, under the matching payment scenario, industrial roundwood and particleboard will experience a sharp decrease in production and an increase in price. For establishment payments, industrial roundwood will experience a continuous increase in production and a decrease in price. For annual payments, the industrial roundwood will experience a V-shape pattern production.
abstract_zh: 作为石油的最大消费国和温室气体排放量第二大的国家，美国在一系列政策的推动下，目前是生物能源生产的领先国家。其中一项直接补贴生物质原料种植者的公共项目是生物质作物援助计划（BCAP），该计划因其对生物能源发展的推动作用而近期受到关注。然而，也有批评意见指出，该计划可能加剧生物能源与林产品之间的原料竞争。因此，本研究旨在利用全球林产品模型（GFPM）评估BCAP对林产品市场的影响。我们设计了三种备选情景，以模拟BCAP中的三类支付。在第一种情景中，通过调整薪材和刨花板的制造成本来模拟配套支付（matching payment）。在第二种情景中，通过调整工业原木的供给速率来模拟建园支付（establishment payment）。在第三种情景中，通过将供给变化率与工业原木的土地租金率挂钩来模拟年度支付（annual payment）。我们发现，在配套支付情景下，工业原木和刨花板的产量将急剧下降，价格上升。对于建园支付，工业原木的产量将持续增长，价格则下降。对于年度支付，工业原木的产量将呈现V形变化。

title: Simple vs. Complex: Implications of Lags in Pollution Delivery for Efficient Load Allocation and Design of Water-quality Trading Programs
abstract: Water-quality markets that allow point-nonpoint trades assume that nonpoint best management practices (BMPs) achieve the targeted reductions as soon as they are implemented. However, changes in water quality in response to BMPs occur over time—from a few months to decades. We simulate emission allocations using static and dynamic-optimization models to determine whether a simple static allocation can produce results comparable economically and environmentally to complex multi-period designs for nitrogen emissions to Chesapeake Bay. We find that static rules provide relatively large cost savings compared to dynamic rules but result in a delay in achievement of water-quality targets.
abstract_zh: 允许点源与非点源之间进行交易的水质市场，假定非点源最佳管理措施（BMP）一旦实施便能立即达到目标减排量。然而，水质对最佳管理措施的响应是随时间逐步发生的，可能需要几个月至数十年。我们运用静态模型和动态优化模型模拟了排放配额分配，以判断在切萨皮克湾氮排放问题上，简单的静态分配方案在经济和环境效果上能否与复杂的多期设计相媲美。我们发现，与动态规则相比，静态规则能带来相对可观的成本节约，但会导致水质目标的实现出现延迟。
